Former league leaders Swansea have fell to eighth and will be aiming for a first win in four matches to ensure they don't drop out of the play-off positions.

Cesar Peixoto's side are third, a point behind leaders Middlesbrough and second-placed Stoke, after Saturday's 2-1 win over Charlton, which extended their unbeaten run to seven games from which they have earned 17 points. The Rams are a point off the bottom and five short of safety after going down 2-0 at Southampton on Saturday, their third defeat in four games while they have won just one of 12 games dating back to 1 September.
